notes.title: Map Update now available!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

Feeling lost in the dark mysteries of [i]The Almost Gone[/i]? The [b]Map Update[/b] will help shed some light on the poignant truths hidden in the beautiful dioramas.

In addition to bug fixes, we have added some [b]quality-of-life settings and adjustments[/b] to improve your experience with the game. This includes:

[list][*] [b]A map of each area is now available[/b] [i]-a minimap has been added to the UI that doubles as a button to open the map[/i]
[*] [b]Scale up the in-game UI text[/b] [i]-so you can go easy on your eyes![/i]
[*] [b]Choose between swipe and button controls[/b][i] -play as you like![/i][/list]

[b]Dive back into the mysterious sceneries of your empty home, eerily deserted streets and abandoned buildings with the Map Update of [i]The Almost Gone[/i][/b]

notes.title: The Almost Gone will release on June 25th!
notes.notes:
The beautiful dioramas of [i]The Almost Gone[/i] will be yours to explore on [b]June 25th[/b]!

[previewyoutube=M2TwGoTKR-0;full][/previewyoutube]

Piece together the story and discover the events that led to your tragic death, as you progress through the empty scenes of your life.

[i]The Almost Gone[/i] will be available at $14.99, with a special [b]20% off launch price[/b] on its first week of release.

notes.title: The Almost Gone set for 2020 Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to confirm that [i]The Almost Gone[/i] will be released this year on PC, Nintendo Switch and Mobile! We are still working on the game to provide the [b]best user experience possible[/b], and will soon run tests on hundreds of devices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35545120/78211756d79a45919c263c3084601cbc10eabf9e.gif[/img]

[i]The Almost Gone[/i] is not only a fancy looking dioramas puzzle game, but it also features an emotional and mature story that we hope will [b]make you shiver[/b].

Feel free to ask any questions about this game in this thread or on our Discord channel: [url=discord.gg/playdigious]discord.gg/playdigious[/url]

Don’t hesitate to follow [url=https://twitter.com/hvgames]@hvgames[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Playdigious]@Playdigious[/url] on Twitter for upcoming news about [i]The Almost Gone[/i]!

Cheers!

Happy Volcano & Playdigious
